environment: Isolated PostgreSQL18/PGlite, actual migrations/routes/shared services; synthetic Clerk and signed Telegram SDK; no real OAuth or production access

checks.name: manual SQL accepts the exact adopted 17-row legacy history plus marker/payment, preserves it and repeats safely without Supabase roles
owner manual SQL upgrades the previous real ledger, preserves users/children/registrations/payments and defaults every old event to restricted
manual SQL repeat and native Drizzle runner are no-ops with exactly one new ledger row
unknown or changed ledger fails atomically without reconciling it
RLS and revoked direct grants protect interest/limits even with hostile Supabase default grants
anonymous public API returns full intended details, never payment links, contacts, families, participants or private events
public browsing and intake never create a lead, account, registration, payment or DB write
Web/Mini App parity mother → restricted = eligible
Web/Mini App parity mother → open = eligible
Web/Mini App parity father → restricted = eligible
Web/Mini App parity father → open = eligible
Web/Mini App parity advanced → restricted = eligible
Web/Mini App parity advanced → open = eligible
Web/Mini App parity completed → restricted = eligible
Web/Mini App parity completed → open = eligible
Web/Mini App parity unspecified → restricted = eligible
Web/Mini App parity unspecified → open = eligible
Web/Mini App parity none → restricted = not_eligible
Web/Mini App parity none → open = eligible
Web/Mini App parity old → restricted = needs_review
Web/Mini App parity old → open = eligible
Web/Mini App parity unfiltered → restricted = needs_review
Web/Mini App parity unfiltered → open = eligible
guest intake keeps early conversion/roots as needs_review and none as not_eligible without canonical category changes
all public title/navigation adapters reject invite-only, closed and unsafe return destinations
restricted registration rechecks current status; client intake/eligibility injection grants nothing
mother can register self on restricted; no completed giyur is inferred
advanced can register self on restricted; no completed giyur is inferred
completed can register self on restricted; no completed giyur is inferred
unspecified can register self on restricted; no completed giyur is inferred
father cannot register an existing child even on an open event
advanced cannot register an existing child even on an open event
unspecified cannot register an existing child even on an open event
none cannot register an existing child even on an open event
eligible mother/completed conversion retains canonical child calculation and immutable pending total
none may register on an explicitly open event; receipt and opening never confirm paid
new open-event profile completes without an affiliation/filter stamp or child rights; restricted registration still fails
real optimistic profile conflict is retained for open profiles and does not overwrite the new revision
ordinary Mini App first profile save uses the canonical optimistic token without assigning affiliation/filter/stage
an anonymous pre-auth draft cannot overwrite a completed ordinary profile even without a religious filter
mocked verified Clerk callback keeps the original open event after ordinary completion, repeats without duplicates and preserves parallel targets
current status is not re-asked; changed canonical status blocks reopening an old pending payment
intentional anonymous contact creates one CRM interest, no account/ticket; repetitions reuse it and invitations default off
consent, contact, strict status/IDOR validation, same-origin and body limits fail closed
foreign idempotency key never overwrites or discloses the original guest contact
guest capability links to a verified account only; neither a name nor supplied email merges identities
contact rate limit is persistent/atomic and duplicate submissions never create extra people
Mini App bootstrap unknown remains unknown without opt-in; explicit consent requires a real permitted chat
unsubscribed/blocked survive bootstrap; block is never cleared by an interest or display
capability unsubscribe is repeatable and explicit Mini App unsubscribe withdraws invitations
CRM staff sees separate guest/linked leads, filters, consent/history and derived registration; ordinary accounts cannot use its actions
new/returning Telegram startup gives public events in one request with HMAC and no returning read writes/locks
none and new Telegram ad entry receive full public event in startup; disabled campaign never launches it
public GET/share reads have zero writes; long aliases are created only by explicit Share POST and remain stable
verified guest-to-existing-interest consolidation preserves append-only history and never merges by name/email
admin removal archives an event with enquiries; public reads close while CRM/history remain intact
